config.label: When set to true, allows configuration values to be overridden via request headers and query parameters
config.description: When set to true, allows configuration values to be overridden via request headers and query parameters.

config.label: Atlas API client ID for authentication
config.description: Atlas API client ID for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

config.label: Atlas API client secret for authentication
config.description: Atlas API client secret for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

config.label: Base URL for the MongoDB Assistant API
config.description: Base URL for the MongoDB Assistant API.

config.label: Time in milliseconds that temporary database users created when connecting to MongoDB Atlas clusters will remain active before being automatically deleted
config.description: Time in milliseconds that temporary database users created when connecting to MongoDB Atlas clusters will remain active before being automatically deleted.

config.label: Comma separated values of tool names that require user confirmation before execution
config.description: Comma separated values of tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Requires the client to support elicitation.

config.label: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime
config.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends — recommended when the HTTP transport is exposed to multiple clients without authentication. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation.

config.label: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections
config.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections. Optional, if not set, you'll need to call the connect tool before interacting with MongoDB data.

config.label: When set to true, disallows the use of server-side JavaScript operators (such as $where, $function, and $accumulator) in query filters and aggregation pipelines
config.description: When set to true, disallows the use of server-side JavaScript operators (such as $where, $function, and $accumulator) in query filters and aggregation pipelines.

config.label: Comma separated values of tool names, operation types, and/or categories of tools that will be disabled
config.description: Comma separated values of tool names, operation types, and/or categories of tools that will be disabled.

config.label: When true, runs the server in dry mode: dumps configuration and enabled tools, then exits without starting the server
config.description: When true, runs the server in dry mode: dumps configuration and enabled tools, then exits without starting the server.

config.label: Time in milliseconds the user has to respond to an elicitation request (such as a tool confirmation prompt) before it fails
config.description: Time in milliseconds the user has to respond to an elicitation request (such as a tool confirmation prompt) before it fails.

config.label: Time in milliseconds between export cleanup cycles that remove expired export files
config.description: Time in milliseconds between export cleanup cycles that remove expired export files.

config.label: Time in milliseconds after which an export is considered expired and eligible for cleanup
config.description: Time in milliseconds after which an export is considered expired and eligible for cleanup.

config.label: Folder to store exported data files
config.description: Folder to store exported data files.

config.label: When true, the HTTP transport allows requests with a session ID supplied externally through the 'mcp-session-id' header
config.description: When true, the HTTP transport allows requests with a session ID supplied externally through the 'mcp-session-id' header. When an external ID is supplied, the initialization request is optional.

config.label: Deprecated
config.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerHost` instead. Host address to bind the healthCheck HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckPort` must also be set.

config.label: Deprecated
config.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerPort` instead. Port number for the healthCheck HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckHost` must also be set.

config.label: Maximum size of the HTTP request body in bytes (only used when transport is 'http')
config.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request body in bytes (only used when transport is 'http'). This value is passed as the optional limit parameter to the Express.js json() middleware.

config.label: Header that the HTTP server will validate when making requests (only used when transport is 'http')
config.description: Header that the HTTP server will validate when making requests (only used when transport is 'http').

config.label: Host address to bind the HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http')
config.description: Host address to bind the HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http').

config.label: Port number for the HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http')
config.description: Port number for the HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). Use 0 for a random port.

config.label: The HTTP response type for tool responses: 'sse' for Server-Sent Events, 'json' for standard JSON responses
config.description: The HTTP response type for tool responses: 'sse' for Server-Sent Events, 'json' for standard JSON responses.

config.label: Idle timeout for a client to disconnect (only applies to http transport)
config.description: Idle timeout for a client to disconnect (only applies to http transport).

config.label: When set to true, enforces that query operations must use an index, rejecting queries that perform a collection scan
config.description: When set to true, enforces that query operations must use an index, rejecting queries that perform a collection scan.

config.label: Folder to store logs
config.description: Folder to store logs.

config.label: Comma separated values of logger types
config.description: Comma separated values of logger types.

config.label: Maximum number of MongoDB connections a single scope (an MCP session by default, see connectionScope) can hold open
config.description: Maximum number of MongoDB connections a single scope (an MCP session by default, see connectionScope) can hold open. When exceeded, the scope's least-recently-used connection is closed and its connectionId revoked. The preconfigured connection does not count towards the limit.

config.label: The maximum size in bytes for results from a find or aggregate tool call
config.description: The maximum size in bytes for results from a find or aggregate tool call. This serves as an upper bound for the responseBytesLimit parameter in those tools.

config.label: The maximum number of documents that can be returned by a find or aggregate tool call
config.description: The maximum number of documents that can be returned by a find or aggregate tool call. For the find tool, the effective limit will be the smaller of this value and the tool's limit parameter.

config.label: Maximum number of concurrent sessions the HTTP transport will hold in memory (only used when transport is 'http')
config.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions the HTTP transport will hold in memory (only used when transport is 'http'). Each session holds a full server instance, transport, and timers, so choose a value based on your deployment's available memory; the default is a conservative safety net rather than a recommended production value.

config.label: The maximum time in milliseconds that operations are allowed to run on the MongoDB server
config.description: The maximum time in milliseconds that operations are allowed to run on the MongoDB server. When set, this value is passed as the maxTimeMS option to read operations such as find, aggregate, and count.

config.label: Minimum severity level for log messages forwarded to the MCP client
config.description: Minimum severity level for log messages forwarded to the MCP client.

config.label: Features to expose on the monitoring server (only used when transport is 'http' and monitoringServerHost/monitoringServerPort are set)
config.description: Features to expose on the monitoring server (only used when transport is 'http' and monitoringServerHost/monitoringServerPort are set).

config.label: Host address to bind the monitoring HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http')
config.description: Host address to bind the monitoring HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerPort` must also be set.

config.label: Port number for the monitoring HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http')
config.description: Port number for the monitoring HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerHost` must also be set.

config.label: Notification timeout for a client to be aware of disconnect (only applies to http transport)
config.description: Notification timeout for a client to be aware of disconnect (only applies to http transport).

config.description: Comma separated values of preview features that are enabled.

config.description: When set to true, only allows read, connect, and metadata operation types, disabling create/update/delete operations.

config.description: When set to disabled, disables telemetry collection.

config.description: Either 'stdio' or 'http'.
